verdict.rationale: Metronome exposes a full REST API (with OpenAPI spec, bearer-token auth, idempotency for safe retries, pagination) and SDKs for Python, Go, Ruby, Node.js, and Java, which enables sending usage events, managing contracts, and ingesting data entirely headlessly/programmatically — suitable for CI or automated pipelines. However, there is no explicit CLI tool or documented CI/CD integration example, so support is inferred from API/SDK design rather than demonstrated automation workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI, explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration, and independent confirmation of headless automation use.
